recipes.name: Oreo Cookie Bark
ingredients_raw: 1 (20 ounce) package chocolate sandwich cookies with creme filling

steps.text: Line a 10x15-inch jellyroll pan with waxed paper. Coat paper with non-stick vegetable spray and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, break half of the cookies into coarse pieces with fingers or the back of a wooden spoon.

In a microwave-safe glass or ceramic mixing bowl, melt one package of the white chocolate according to package directions. Remove from microwave and quickly fold in broken cookie pieces. Pour mixture into prepared pan and spread to cover half the pan.
Repeat process with remaining chocolate and cookies, spreading mixture into the other half of pan. Refrigerate until solid, about 1 hour.
Remove bark from the pan and carefully peel off waxed paper. Place bark on a large cutting board and cut with a large chef's knife. Store in airtight container.

raw_recipe.headline: Oreo Cookie Bark
raw_recipe.description: This is really more of a candy than a cookie, but it is always a hit on my cookie trays!

review.reviewBody: You may be a little put off by the fact that this recipe has only two ingredients. DON'T BE. I've made this recipe about a hundred times and every time it is the hit of the party. It's addictive, and you can't mess it up! I so enjoy answering the question, "How did you make this?" because no one can ever believe how easy it is. Here are two tips: First, instead of white chocolate chips, I use two packages of vanilla candy coating. It's a little sweeter and has this pleasing melt-in-your-mouth quality. And second, after you crush the oreos, put them in a colander to sift off the powdery part of the cookie crumbs. The powder will darken the white chocolate and it won't be as pretty. I wish I could give this recipe 50 stars!

These were great. Everyone thought they tasted just like the cookies and cream candy bar. I used foil for the bottom. Then I used a knock of brand of oreos and 2 packages of vanilla coating. I used a different method though. Break off half of the carton of oreos and place in pan. Melt half of vanilla coating and spread on top. Then melt other half of coating and spread evenly and sink the rest of the broken cookies on top. This worked way better and didn't make the vanilla coating black! I will use a 9x13 pan next time to make it thicker and better.

Absolutely addicting! I used three 11oz. bags of Ghiradelli white chocolate chips. I didn't use quite an entire package of Oreo cookies. I think it would have been easier to melt the chocolate in a double boiler as opposed to using the microwave. The double boiler melts it more evenly and the chocolate is smoother and easier to spread. It is very easy to make and even easier to eat! ;)

Easy recipes with great results but I changed mine up. First I broke up oreos and pretzel sticks and laid them on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Melted 1-2 lbs of Wilton Vanilla Candy melts and poured over my Oreo/pretzel mix. Then sprinkled red, white & blue M & M's and 4th of July cupcake sprinkles over the top. Let it harden up, broke them in pieces and put in bags tied with sparkly 4th of July ribbon! SO cute! I will be making the same concoction at Halloween and christmas only changing the color theme!

Kids love this very sweet candy - a Christmas tradition. We use three bags of Ghirardelli 11 oz white chocolate and one 8 oz bag of mini Oreos. To keep the white as white as possible, I suggest first put Oreos in colander to get rid of little crumbs, then mix 1.5 bags of melted white chocolate with all of the Oreos. Then spread into 9x13 pan (not jelly roll). Melt the remaining white chocolate chips and spread on top of the previous mixture.

Quick and Easy!!! My 18 year old son loved it. I made goodies bags for the girls at work and they all enjoyed their treat. It was a little sweet for some, but you can never please everyone. I used two 12 oz bags of the white/vanilla flavored Candy Melts and one bag of Oreo mini's. I spread half the melted mixture into the pan, placed a layer using half of the mini cookies evenly spaced, covered with the rest of the melted mixture, and topped with the remaining cookies in the open spaces. I also sprinkled the crumbs only on the top for texture and color. It came out perfect and did not look "dirty" like some other reviewers described. Thank you for sharing this recipe. I will definitely make it again.

I made several batches in the matter of a couple of days, this is a total 5 star recipe. My little neighbor kids called it "Cookies and Creme Candy" and all the kids just went to town. I mean to tell you when they all have their mouths full saying how good it is...and barely understanding them but showing thumbs up and hmm and awws and ohhhs.....it must be really really good. The last batch I did was with mini oreos and let me tell you this, if you don't want to make a huge batch that this recipe calls for...simple trick is 1 package of almond bark and 1 8oz package of Oreo Minis...and follow the recipe. Only note is, you don't have to break up the minis. They are already in bite size pieces. This is a fun recipe. Hands down.

Made this recipe using two and a half bags of Meijer-brand vanilla baking chips and a 15 oz bag of oreos. Turned out truly delightful! Also tried the recipe with cool mint and the family loved it. A lovely treat for the family, or for a gift! Will definitely be making again. My only tip is that if you crush about 2/3 of the cookies and separate the other 1/3 into chunks it is easier to work with. First time making it I crushed half and cracked the other half and it was a bit hard to deal with. Delicious recipe! :).

Delicious!!! If you love Oreo cookies and white chocolate, this is the treat for you. Perfect for a quick dessert. Very easy to make. Make sure you add a little more white chocolate because it can get to chunky. I used three packages of white chocolate from Ghirardelli. This is an awesome recipe for the holidays because you can use the Oreos with the orange or chocolate filling for Halloween or Thanksgiving, as well as the Oreos with the red filling for Christmas, New Years, or even Valentine's Day.

Super easy and so good! I always make this at Christmas time and use dark chocolate mint wafers and candy cane Oreos. I just melt both bags of chocolate and add all the Oreos rather than making two batches as the recipe states. It is pretty thick but Still covers the entire pan. I break it up into bite size pieces and it always disappears!

This recipe is super easy and everyone loves it! Who doesn't love Oreos??
My only issue is with the measurements - I had to tweak it a bit to make it work for me. When I followed the recipe exactly I basically got broken up Oreo pieces with a very thin layering of white chocolate holding them together. I was looking for a more prominent chocolate to Oreo ratio.
A 20 oz package of Oreos is one of the big family pack of cookies with 4 rows. It turned out really well for me when I did 2.5 rows of cookies with 20 oz of white chocolate. (Less cookies, more chocolate).
Will make again!

Being in Canada and using metric it makes it challenging to know how many grams of chocolate and cookies to use. I used about 1.5 cups of melted white wafers for a 270 gram box of cookies. I then used a package of semi sweet chocolate for the second box of cookies. I got the calculator and scale out to try and find the right amount. Could all recipes offer metric as well considering many Canadians are using this site? Overall they turned out Ok and is an easy recipe for people who don’t want the hassle of multiple ingredients and time spent.
This was super easy to make and was a hit at the extended family Christmas get together. This will surely become a staple for years to come!
Did the original recipe was yummy kids loved it

This was incredible, kudos Kathy! My husband made it using Double Stuff Oreos and we just can't say enough good things about it. We both have a sweet tooth and this was perfect. It was the one treat we served for Christmas that I couldn't walk passed without grabbing a piece. Just outstanding!!!!
Every time I make this I get wonderful reviews. I like to make it with chocolate chips too.
I love making things like this .it's so good..thank you Virginia Leonard
